subject.title: refactor(agents): converge run staleness policy onto diagnostic activity owner

question: Should diagnostic run activity become the permanent owner of the stale-run takeover threshold shared by reply reclamation and embedded steering?
rationale: Source, tests, and live proof support the refactor, but the protected maintainer label and recent provenance make the owner-boundary choice an explicit human decision.

options.title: Approve shared owner
options.body: Accept diagnostic run activity as the canonical threshold owner because the patch removes duplicate policy without changing consumer clocks or behavior.

options.title: Keep registry-local ownership
options.body: Retain separate policy definitions if reply reclamation and embedded steering are intentionally expected to evolve independently.

recommendation.title: Approve shared owner
recommendation.body: Accept diagnostic run activity as the canonical threshold owner because the patch removes duplicate policy without changing consumer clocks or behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and merged the current coordinated staleness contract across all affected production paths.
